title.tr: Bahçe İçin Ahşap Depo, Tek Kapılı
title.en: Wooden Garden Storage Shed with Single Door

alt.tr: Evin bahçesinde yatay ahşap kaplamalı, tek kapılı, iki havalandırma ızgaralı ve kırmızı çatılı depo
alt.en: Garden storage shed with horizontal wood cladding, a single door, two vent grilles and a red roof

caption.tr: Ev duvarına yaslanan bahçe deposu: yatay ahşap kaplama, ortada tek kanatlı kapı, iki yanda havalandırma ızgarası.
caption.en: A garden shed built against the house wall: horizontal wood cladding, a single-leaf door in the middle and a vent grille on each side.
